features: Scoring Tests Dashboard now starts with separate Manual Scoring and Automatic Scoring choices matching the Production Scoring Dashboard
Selected Test scoring mode is stored in the admin session before entering the test workflow
Adds shared HeatsScoringEngine as the single Heats/Semifinal ranking and callback engine
Production and Test Generate Results actions now route through shared ScoringCalculationService
Shared calculation uses ScoringRulesService for participant tier selection and YES/A1/A2/A3 weights
Normal tiering uses the larger Leader/Follower role count unless manually overridden
Special categories bypass participant-count tiering in the shared calculation path
Final scoring continues to use the shared RelativePlacementCalculator
Legacy local computeResults functions remain only as rollback compatibility and are bypassed in normal Generate Results use
No Staging or Production deployment performed
